Title: Verify requester can open Create Purchase Request page
Precondition: Requester user exists and is logged in
Steps:
1. Login as requester
2. Navigate to Purchase Request
3. Click Create Request
Expected Result: Create Purchase Request page opens successfully

Title: Verify requester can save draft with valid required fields
Precondition: Requester is on Create Request page
Steps:
1. Enter valid item
2. Enter valid amount
3. Select department
4. Click Save Draft
Expected Result: Draft is saved and request ID is generated

Title: Verify required fields are enforced
Precondition: Requester is on Create Request page
Steps:
1. Enter item and amount
2. Leave department blank
3. Click Submit
Expected Result: System blocks submission and displays required field validation

Title: Verify amount cannot be zero
Precondition: Requester is on Create Request page
Steps:
1. Enter valid item
2. Enter amount 0
3. Complete other required fields
4. Click Submit
Expected Result: System rejects amount and displays validation message

Title: Verify amount cannot be negative
Precondition: Requester is on Create Request page
Steps:
1. Enter valid item
2. Enter negative amount
3. Complete other required fields
4. Click Submit
Expected Result: System rejects negative amount

Title: Verify minimum valid amount is accepted
Precondition: Requester is on Create Request page
Steps:
1. Enter required details
2. Enter amount 1
3. Click Submit
Expected Result: Request is submitted successfully if minimum amount is allowed

Title: Verify requester can submit valid request for approval
Steps:
1. Open draft request
2. Review details
3. Click Submit
Expected Result: Request status changes to Pending Approval

Title: Verify already submitted request cannot be submitted again
Steps:
1. Open pending request
2. Check available actions
Expected Result: Submit action is not available or duplicate submission is blocked

Title: Verify approver can approve pending request
Steps:
1. Login as approver
2. Open assigned request
3. Click Approve
4. Confirm approval
Expected Result: Request status changes to Approved

Title: Verify approver can reject pending request with reason
Steps:
1. Login as approver
2. Open pending request
3. Click Reject
4. Enter reason
5. Confirm rejection
Expected Result: Request status changes to Rejected and reason is saved

Title: Verify rejection without reason is blocked
Steps:
1. Login as approver
2. Open pending request
3. Click Reject
4. Leave reason blank
5. Confirm rejection
Expected Result: System blocks rejection and displays required reason validation

Title: Verify requester cannot approve own request
Steps:
1. Login as requester
2. Open own pending request
3. Check approval actions
Expected Result: Approve and Reject actions are not available

Title: Verify unauthorized user cannot access approval page
Precondition: User does not have approver role
Steps:
1. Login as unauthorized user
2. Navigate to approval page
Expected Result: System denies access or hides approval page

Title: Verify request list displays Pending Approval after submission
Steps:
1. Submit request
2. Navigate to request list
3. Search request ID
Expected Result: Request list shows status as Pending Approval

Title: Verify request list displays Approved after approval
Steps:
1. Approve request
2. Navigate to request list
3. Search request ID
Expected Result: Request list shows status as Approved

Title: Verify detail page and list status are consistent
Steps:
1. Open request list
2. Note status
3. Open request details
4. Compare status
Expected Result: Request list and detail page show the same status

Title: Verify create action appears in request history
Steps:
1. Open request history
2. Check action records
Expected Result: Create action is recorded with actor and timestamp

Title: Verify approval action appears in request history
Steps:
1. Open approved request
2. Check request history
Expected Result: Approve action is recorded with approver and timestamp

Title: Verify approved request is read-only for requester
Steps:
1. Login as requester
2. Open approved request
3. Attempt to edit amount/item fields
Expected Result: Protected fields are disabled and cannot be saved

Title: Verify requester cannot save changes to approved request
Steps:
1. Login as requester
2. Open approved request
3. Attempt to change details
4. Click Save if available
Expected Result: System blocks update or Save is unavailable

Title: Verify create draft still works after approval fix
Steps:
1. Login as requester
2. Create draft
3. Save draft
Expected Result: Draft creation still works

Title: Verify submit request still works after status fix
Steps:
1. Open draft
2. Submit for approval
Expected Result: Submission still works and status updates correctly

Title: Verify approve and reject still work after validation fix
Steps:
1. Approve one pending request
2. Reject another with reason
Expected Result: Approval and rejection flows still work

Title: Verify request history remains correct after deployment
Steps:
1. Open request history
2. Validate action records
Expected Result: History remains accurate and complete

Title: Verify core workflow smoke check after deployment
Steps:
1. Login
2. Create request
3. Submit
4. Approve
5. Check status
Expected Result: Core purchase request workflow works after deployment
